text.Nesting Grounds:
How to play ==
At any time during your turn, gain 2 Trade. If you have another Blob card in play, gain 4 Combat. Nesting Ground is a base with defense 5. 
 Strategy ==
This card is the much stronger alternative to the Spike Cluster: all of its stats are considerably better. In early game it is useful even in a deck without other Blob cards, since it provides 2 Trade every turn and has a decent defense of 5. Later it is still very useful in a Blob-rich deck, both for its own abilities and for providing other Blob cards with allies. It is not that useful anymore in a deck without many other Blob cards, and then it is a shame that it cannot scrap itself.
